div.l: Whate welcome be cutt a goddes name .
Nowe let vs ryde and herken whate I sey
And with at worde we ryden forth oure wey
And he began with right a mery chere
And seyde anone . his tale as ye shalle here . //
Explicit . Prologus .

l.hi: Here begynneth the knyghtes tale folowynge

div.l: Whilom as olde story telleth vs
There was a duke that hight Theseus
Of Tebes he was lorde and gouernoure
And in his tyme suche a conqueroure
hat gretter was there noon vnder the sonne
Fulle many a riche countre had he wonne
That with his wisdome . and chyualrye
He conquered alle the reame of femenye
That whilom was cleped Sithea
And wedde the quene Ipolita
And brought hir home in to his Couintre
With moche glorie and solempnyte
And eke hir yonge sustre Emelye
And thus with victory and melodye
Lete I this worthy duke to Athenes ryde
And alle his hoste in armes hym beside
And certes if it nere to longe to here
I wolde haue tolde fully the matere
